blocks.text: Qo'shimchalar qo'shilganda so'z oxirining o'zgarishi qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 120-dars): `-s` / `-es`, `-ing`, `-ed`, `-er` / `-est`, `-ly`, `e` ning tushishi, `y` → `i` va qisqa so'zlarda undoshning ikkilanishi (stop → stopped). B1–B2 darajasida so'zlar uzunlashadi va qoidalar nozik bo'ladi: ko'p bo'g'inli so'zlarda qachon ikkilanadi (preferred, lekin offered), Britaniya imlosining o'ziga xos belgilari (travelled, colour, centre, organise, practise), lotincha ko'pliklar (crises, criteria), `ie` / `ei` va hatto ingliz tilida so'zlashuvchilar ham xato yozadigan so'zlar. Oxirida — o'zbek o'quvchilari eng ko'p adashadigan bosh harflar.

Qoida qizil kitobdagi bilan bir xil: so'z **bitta unli + bitta undosh** bilan tugasa va urg'u **oxirgi bo'g'inda** bo'lsa, unli bilan boshlanadigan qo'shimcha oldidan undosh ikkilanadi. Ko'p bo'g'inli so'zlarda shuning uchun urg'uni bilish kerak: prefer, refer, occur, admit, regret, forget, control — urg'u oxirgi bo'g'inda, ikkilanadi; offer, suffer, visit, limit, target, budget, develop, benefit — urg'u birinchi bo'g'inda, ikkilanmaydi. Urg'u ko'chsa, ikkilanish ham yo'qoladi: prefer → prefe**rr**ed, lekin prefe**r**ence, prefe**r**able.

blocks.text: Britaniya imlosida **unli + `l`** bilan tugagan so'z urg'udan qat'i nazar `l` ni ikkilaydi: travel → trave**ll**ed, trave**ll**er; Amerikada esa traveled. Aksincha, `-ll` bilan tugagan ba'zi so'zlar Britaniyada `-ful`, `-ment` oldidan bitta `l` ga tushadi: skill → ski**l**ful, fulfil, enrolment, instalment. `-c` bilan tugagan fe'llar `-ed`, `-ing`, `-er`, `-y` oldidan `k` oladi, aks holda o'qilishi o'zgarib qoladi: panic → pani**ck**ed.

blocks.text: Mashhur qoida: «**i** before **e**, except after **c**» — odatda `ie`, lekin `c` dan keyin `ei`: bel**ie**ve, ach**ie**ve, n**ie**ce, f**ie**ld, p**ie**ce — rec**ei**ve, c**ei**ling, dec**ei**ve, rec**ei**pt. Qoidaning istisnolari ko'p, ularni alohida yodlang: w**ei**rd, s**ei**ze, th**ei**r, for**ei**gn, h**ei**ght, l**ei**sure, n**ei**ghbour, **ei**ther, n**ei**ther — va aksincha, `c` dan keyin `ie`: sc**ie**nce, anc**ie**nt, suffic**ie**nt, effic**ie**nt.

blocks.text: O'zbek tilida hafta kunlari, oylar, millat va til nomlari **kichik** harf bilan yoziladi: dushanba, may, o'zbek tili. Ingliz tilida esa ular doim **bosh** harf bilan yoziladi. Bu o'zbek o'quvchilarining eng ko'p uchraydigan imlo xatosi — insho va xatlarda ayniqsa ko'zga tashlanadi.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «on monday», «in january», «english language» → on **M**onday, in **J**anuary, the **E**nglish language; «my friend and i» → my friend and **I**; «prefered», «occured», «begining» → prefe**rr**ed, occu**rr**ed, begi**nn**ing; «travelled» va «traveled» ni bitta matnda aralashtirish — Britaniya imlosida doim **travelled**; «panicing» → pani**ck**ing; «noticable» → notic**e**able; «arguement» → argument; «hapiness» → happiness; «crisises», «phenomenons» → cris**es**, phenomen**a**; «I practice every day» (Britaniyada fe'l) → I practi**s**e.

Britaniya imlosi uchun bitta qoida: **izchil bo'ling**. Matnni colour, centre, travelled bilan boshlagan bo'lsangiz, oxirigacha shu uslubda yozing; organise yoki organize dan bittasini tanlang va almashtirmang. Shubhali so'zni lug'atdan tekshirganda **UK** belgisiga qarang. Ko'p xato yoziladigan so'zlarni o'zingizning «qora ro'yxatingiz» qilib, telefoningizda saqlang.
Bog'liq darslar: → qizil kitob, 120-dars (imloning asosiy qoidalari); noto'g'ri fe'llarning shakllari → 146-dars; Britaniya va Amerika imlosi farqlari to'liq jadvalda → 152-dars; ko'plik → 79-dars.

examples.title: Doubling in longer words: **preferred**, but **offered**
examples.description: Ko'p bo'g'inli so'zlarda undosh urg'u oxirgi bo'g'inda bo'lsagina ikkilanadi: preferred, admitted, occurred, regretted, forgetting. Urg'u oldinroq bo'lsa — yo'q: offered, targeted, benefited, focused.

sentences.text: Most of the students **preferred** online lessons to evening classes.
sentences.translation: Talabalarning ko'pchiligi kechki darslardan ko'ra onlayn darslarni **afzal ko'rishdi**.

sentences.text: My grandmother **was referred** to a specialist in Tashkent by her doctor.
sentences.translation: Shifokor buvimni Toshkentdagi mutaxassisga **yo'naltirdi**.

sentences.text: At a busy crossroads near Chorsu, a serious accident **occurred** this morning.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab Chorsu yaqinidagi gavjum chorrahada jiddiy avariya **sodir bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: In the end, the minister **admitted** that mistakes had been made.
sentences.translation: Oxir-oqibat vazir xatolarga yo'l qo'yilganini **tan oldi**.

sentences.text: Sardor **regretted** selling his old guitar as soon as the buyer left.
sentences.translation: Xaridor ketishi bilanoq Sardor eski gitarasini sotganidan **afsuslandi**.

sentences.text: I keep **forgetting** my password, so I've written it down somewhere safe.
sentences.translation: Parolimni doim **unutib qo'yaman**, shuning uchun uni xavfsiz joyga yozib qo'ydim.

sentences.text: The bank **offered** me a loan, but the interest rate was far too high.
sentences.translation: Bank menga kredit **taklif qildi**, lekin foiz stavkasi haddan tashqari baland edi.

sentences.text: Teenagers and young adults **were targeted** by the new advertising campaign.
sentences.translation: Yangi reklama kampaniyasi o'smirlar va yoshlarni **nishonga olgan edi**.

sentences.text: Our company has **benefited** greatly from the new trade agreement.
sentences.translation: Kompaniyamiz yangi savdo kelishuvidan katta **foyda ko'rdi**.

sentences.text: Discussions at the conference **focused** on water shortages in Central Asia.
sentences.translation: Konferensiyadagi muhokamalar Markaziy Osiyodagi suv tanqisligiga **qaratildi**.

examples.title: British spelling: **travelled**, **skilful**, **panicked**
examples.description: Britaniya imlosida unli + `l` bilan tugagan fe'llarda `l` doim ikkilanadi (travelled, labelled), skilful va instalment esa bitta `l` bilan. `-c` bilan tugagan fe'llar `-ed` / `-ing` oldidan `k` oladi: panicked, picnicking.

sentences.text: We **travelled** across Uzbekistan by train last spring.
sentences.translation: O'tgan bahorda O'zbekiston bo'ylab poyezdda **sayohat qildik**.

sentences.text: Our flight to Istanbul **was cancelled** because of the fog.
sentences.translation: Tuman tufayli Istanbulga reysimiz **bekor qilindi**.

sentences.text: All the boxes **were** carefully **labelled** before the move.
sentences.translation: Ko'chishdan oldin barcha qutilarga ehtiyotkorlik bilan **yorliq yopishtirildi**.

sentences.text: The two brothers **quarrelled** about money and haven't spoken since.
sentences.translation: Ikki aka-uka pul ustida **janjallashib qolishdi** va o'shandan beri gaplashmaydi.

sentences.text: When the lights went out, some passengers **panicked** and started shouting.
sentences.translation: Chiroqlar o'chganda ba'zi yo'lovchilar **vahimaga tushib**, baqira boshladi.

sentences.text: Families were **picnicking** on the grass beside the Ankhor canal.
sentences.translation: Oilalar Anhor kanali bo'yidagi maysazorda **piknik qilishardi**.

sentences.text: The comedian **mimicked** the president's voice so well that everyone laughed.
sentences.translation: Komik prezidentning ovoziga shunchalik yaxshi **taqlid qildiki**, hamma kulib yubordi.

sentences.text: Drug **trafficking** is one of the biggest problems on that border.
sentences.translation: Giyohvand moddalar **savdosi** o'sha chegaradagi eng katta muammolardan biri.

sentences.text: Being a **skilful** negotiator, Kamila got a much better deal than we expected.
sentences.translation: **Mohir** muzokarachi bo'lgani uchun Kamila biz kutgandan ancha yaxshi shartnoma tuzdi.

sentences.text: Have you paid the first **instalment** of your university fees yet?
sentences.translation: Universitet to'lovining birinchi **qismini** to'ladingizmi?

examples.title: **e** dropped or kept: **usable**, **noticeable**, **dyeing**
examples.description: `e` unli qo'shimcha oldidan tushadi (usable, famous), lekin `-ce` / `-ge` + `-able` / `-ous` da qoladi (noticeable, courageous); argument, truly — istisno; die → dying, dye → dyeing.

sentences.text: There's been a **noticeable** improvement in your writing since September.
sentences.translation: Sentyabrdan beri yozishingizda **sezilarli** yaxshilanish bo'ldi.

sentences.text: It was a **courageous** decision to leave a safe job and start a business.
sentences.translation: Xavfsiz ishni tashlab biznes boshlash **jasoratli** qaror edi.

sentences.text: Is the old printer still **usable**, or should we throw it away?
sentences.translation: Eski printer hali **ishlatishga yaroqlimi** yoki uni tashlab yuboraylikmi?

sentences.text: Samarkand is **famous** for its blue domes and its bread.
sentences.translation: Samarqand moviy gumbazlari va noni bilan **mashhur**.

sentences.text: We had a terrible **argument** about whose turn it was to wash the dishes.
sentences.translation: Idish yuvish kimning navbati ekani haqida dahshatli **janjal** chiqdi.

sentences.text: I'm **truly** sorry for missing your graduation ceremony.
sentences.translation: Bitiruv marosimingga kelolmaganim uchun **chin dildan** uzr so'rayman.

sentences.text: Grandma is **dyeing** the wool with onion skins, just like her mother did.
sentences.translation: Buvim xuddi onasi kabi junni piyoz po'chog'i bilan **bo'yayapti**.

sentences.text: This old tradition is slowly **dying** out in the cities.
sentences.translation: Bu qadimiy an'ana shaharlarda asta-sekin **yo'qolib bormoqda**.

sentences.text: Is the workload **manageable**, or do you need more help?
sentences.translation: Ish hajmi **eplab bo'ladiganmi** yoki sizga ko'proq yordam kerakmi?

sentences.text: Why are you **lying** on the floor? — My back hurts after the gym.
sentences.translation: Nega polda **yotibsan**? — Sport zalidan keyin belim og'riyapti.

examples.title: **y** to **i**: **happiness**, **business**, but **shyly**
examples.description: Undosh + y dan keyin `-ness`, `-ful`, `-ous`, `-ly` oldidan y → i: happiness, plentiful, mysterious. Istisnolar: shy → shyly, dry → dryness; unli + y odatda saqlanadi (employer), lekin day → daily.

sentences.text: Money can't buy **happiness**, but it can make life a lot easier.
sentences.translation: Pul **baxtni** sotib ololmaydi, lekin hayotni ancha yengillashtiradi.

sentences.text: My uncle runs a small **business** selling dried fruit to Russia.
sentences.translation: Amakim Rossiyaga quritilgan meva sotadigan kichik **biznes** yuritadi.

sentences.text: **Loneliness** is a serious problem for many elderly people living alone.
sentences.translation: **Yolg'izlik** yolg'iz yashaydigan ko'plab keksalar uchun jiddiy muammo.

sentences.text: Apricots are **plentiful** in Fergana in June, so they're very cheap.
sentences.translation: Iyunda Farg'onada o'rik **mo'l-ko'l**, shuning uchun juda arzon.

sentences.text: A **mysterious** parcel arrived at our door with no name or address.
sentences.translation: Eshigimiz oldiga ismi ham, manzili ham yo'q **sirli** posilka keldi.

sentences.text: The little girl smiled **shyly** and hid behind her father.
sentences.translation: Qizcha **uyalib** jilmaydi va otasining orqasiga berkindi.

sentences.text: The **dryness** of the air in summer makes my skin crack.
sentences.translation: Yozda havoning **quruqligi** terimni yoriltirib yuboradi.

sentences.text: I check my email **daily**, but I rarely reply at weekends.
sentences.translation: Elektron pochtamni **har kuni** tekshiraman, lekin dam olish kunlari kamdan-kam javob beraman.

sentences.text: My **employer** has agreed to pay for an English course.
sentences.translation: **Ish beruvchim** ingliz tili kursi uchun pul to'lashga rozi bo'ldi.

sentences.text: The children's **laziness** in the mornings drives their mother mad.
sentences.translation: Bolalarning ertalabki **dangasaligi** onalarining jonini oladi.

examples.title: Tricky plurals: **crises**, **criteria**, **heroes**, **beliefs**
examples.description: B1–B2 matnlaridagi qiyin ko'pliklar: lotin va yunon so'zlari (crises, criteria, phenomena, analyses), `-o` (heroes, lekin photos), `-f` (thieves, lekin beliefs), qo'shma otlar (passers-by).

sentences.text: The country has survived several economic **crises** since independence.
sentences.translation: Mamlakat mustaqillikdan beri bir nechta iqtisodiy **inqirozni** boshdan kechirdi.

sentences.text: What are the **criteria** for choosing the winner of the competition?
sentences.translation: Tanlov g'olibini tanlash **mezonlari** qanday?

sentences.text: The northern lights and other natural **phenomena** attract thousands of tourists to Norway.
sentences.translation: Qutb yog'dusi va boshqa tabiat **hodisalari** Norvegiyaga minglab sayyohlarni jalb qiladi.

sentences.text: The **media** have been criticised for ignoring the story.
sentences.translation: **Ommaviy axborot vositalari** bu voqeani e'tiborsiz qoldirgani uchun tanqid qilindi.

sentences.text: Firefighters are the real **heroes** of this terrible summer.
sentences.translation: O't o'chiruvchilar bu dahshatli yozning haqiqiy **qahramonlari**.

sentences.text: Can you send me the **photos** from the wedding? I haven't seen any yet.
sentences.translation: To'ydagi **suratlarni** menga yuborib bera olasizmi? Hali birortasini ko'rmadim.

sentences.text: Two **thieves** were arrested after stealing phones from the market.
sentences.translation: Bozordan telefon o'g'irlagan ikki **o'g'ri** qo'lga olindi.

sentences.text: People of all religions and **beliefs** are welcome at the festival.
sentences.translation: Festivalga barcha din va **e'tiqod** vakillari taklif etiladi.

sentences.text: Several **passers-by** stopped to help the old man who had fallen.
sentences.translation: Bir nechta **o'tkinchi** yiqilib tushgan qariyaga yordam berish uchun to'xtadi.

sentences.text: Scientists carried out detailed **analyses** of the water samples.
sentences.translation: Olimlar suv namunalarining batafsil **tahlillarini** o'tkazishdi.

examples.title: **ie** or **ei**? And words people often misspell
examples.description: «c dan keyin ei, boshqa joyda ie»: believe, achieve, niece — receive, receipt. Istisnolar: weird, foreign. Hamda ko'p xato yoziladigan so'zlar: accommodation, necessary, definitely, separate, embarrassed.

sentences.text: I **believe** that hard work matters more than talent.
sentences.translation: Mehnat iste'doddan muhimroq, deb **ishonaman**.

sentences.text: Did you **receive** my email about the new timetable?
sentences.translation: Yangi jadval haqidagi xatimni **oldingizmi**?

sentences.text: Please keep the **receipt** in case you need to return the jacket.
sentences.translation: Kurtkani qaytarishga to'g'ri kelsa, **chekni** saqlab qo'ying.

sentences.text: My **niece** has just **achieved** the highest score in her school.
sentences.translation: **Jiyanim** maktabida eng yuqori natijaga **erishdi**.

sentences.text: There's something **weird** about that house — the lights are always on.
sentences.translation: O'sha uyda nimadir **g'alati** — chiroqlari doim yonib turadi.

sentences.text: Learning a **foreign** language opens a lot of doors.
sentences.translation: **Chet** tilini o'rganish ko'p eshiklarni ochadi.

sentences.text: Is breakfast included in the price of the **accommodation**?
sentences.translation: Nonushta **turar joy** narxiga kiradimi?

sentences.text: It isn't **necessary** to book in advance, but it's **definitely** a good idea.
sentences.translation: Oldindan band qilish **shart emas**, lekin bu **albatta** yaxshi fikr.

sentences.text: Keep the raw meat **separate** from the vegetables.
sentences.translation: Xom go'shtni sabzavotlardan **alohida** saqlang.

sentences.text: I was so **embarrassed** when my phone rang in the middle of the exam.
sentences.translation: Imtihonning o'rtasida telefonim jiringlaganda juda **uyalib ketdim**.

examples.title: British **-our**, **-re**, **-ise**: colour, centre, organise
examples.description: Britaniya imlosi: `-our` (colour, behaviour — lekin humorous), `-re` (centre, litre), `-ise` / `-yse` (organise, analyse), ot `-ce` — fe'l `-se` (practice / practise, licence), defence.

sentences.text: My grandmother's **favourite colour** is turquoise, like the domes in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Buvimning **sevimli rangi** — Samarqanddagi gumbazlardek feruza.

sentences.text: The children's **behaviour** has improved a lot since the new teacher arrived.
sentences.translation: Yangi o'qituvchi kelganidan beri bolalarning **xulq-atvori** ancha yaxshilandi.

sentences.text: He tells such **humorous** stories that everyone wants to sit next to him.
sentences.translation: U shunday **kulgili** hikoyalar aytadiki, hamma uning yonida o'tirishni xohlaydi.

sentences.text: The new shopping **centre** has a cinema, a bowling alley and a huge food court.
sentences.translation: Yangi savdo **markazida** kinoteatr, boulling zali va katta ovqatlanish zonasi bor.

sentences.text: We bought two **litres** of milk and a kilo of cherries at the bazaar.
sentences.translation: Bozordan ikki **litr** sut va bir kilo gilos oldik.

sentences.text: Who's going to **organise** the farewell party for our teacher?
sentences.translation: O'qituvchimiz uchun xayrlashuv ziyofatini kim **tashkil qiladi**?

sentences.text: Experts are still trying to **analyse** the causes of the accident.
sentences.translation: Mutaxassislar hali ham avariya sabablarini **tahlil qilishga** urinishyapti.

sentences.text: You need more **practice** before the exam, so **practise** every evening.
sentences.translation: Imtihondan oldin sizga ko'proq **mashq** kerak, shuning uchun har kuni kechqurun **mashq qiling**.

sentences.text: Aziz finally got his driving **licence** after failing the test twice.
sentences.translation: Aziz imtihondan ikki marta yiqilgandan keyin nihoyat haydovchilik **guvohnomasini** oldi.

sentences.text: In the final, Pakhtakor's **defence** was much stronger than their opponents'.
sentences.translation: Finalda Paxtakorning **himoyasi** raqibnikidan ancha kuchli edi.

examples.title: Capital letters, **-ful** and **all-**: habits to break
examples.description: Inglizchada hafta kunlari, oylar, til va millat nomlari, unvonlar va I bosh harf bilan yoziladi (o'zbekchada kichik harf). `-ful` va `all-` bitta l bilan: careful, hopeful, already, although — lekin all right.

sentences.text: Our next meeting is on **Wednesday**, the second of **February**.
sentences.translation: Navbatdagi yig'ilishimiz ikkinchi **fevral**, **chorshanba** kuni.

sentences.text: Madina speaks **Uzbek**, **Russian** and **English**, and she's learning **Korean**.
sentences.translation: Madina **o'zbek**, **rus** va **ingliz** tillarida gapiradi, hozir **koreys** tilini o'rganyapti.

sentences.text: Several **Japanese** companies have opened offices in Tashkent recently.
sentences.translation: Yaqinda bir nechta **yapon** kompaniyalari Toshkentda ofis ochdi.

sentences.text: We visited **Professor** Yusupova, who teaches **Islamic** history at the university.
